race.description: Ladbrokes More On Tote Win Mdn Plate
race.comment: MONGOLIAN HERO (8) is the one to beat after two solid fourths to start the campaign, the latest at this track when beaten a length after being held up from the 300m. He is third-up, rates strongly on recent form and gets the chance to turn those close efforts into a maiden win with Jamie Melham taking the ride. GALIVAD (4) resumes after eight months and brings a tidy debut fourth at Ballarat, where he tracked the speed and was beaten just under three lengths. Should be fit enough and will give a sight. CAPITAL AFFAIR (12) made sharp improvement when third at this venue on soft ground, beaten just over a length and with luck from the gate she'll run well. TECKNOKING (5) looks to have the ability.
